example_prompt: Check whether my Cartflox transfer salary-2026-09-awa has reached the recipient.

id.description: Transfer `id` or `reference`. Passed as a path parameter.

reference.description: Cartflox reference, sent to the provider. Also accepted by `GET /v1/transfers/{id}`.

status.description:
`pending`: created, not handed to the provider yet. `processing`: handed to the provider, the operator is processing it (the most frequent state right after the call).
`succeeded`: the money reached the recipient, `completed` carries the date. `failed`: refused by the operator or the provider, `failure` says why, nothing was debited.

fee.description: Cartflox fee. `0` with your own gateway keys.

provider_operator.description: Operator code as the provider names it (`ORANGE_CIV`).

provider_reference.description: Reference at the provider, when it differs from `reference`.

livemode.description: `true` for a production object, `false` for a test object: created with a test key, or in a workspace not switched live yet. Verify webhook signatures with the secret key of the same mode.

error_schema.description: Error body. `code` is present on transfer endpoints.

gotchas: id accepts the Cartflox transfer id or its reference.

Only succeeded and failed are final: pending is not handed to the provider yet, processing is with the operator (the usual state right after the call). succeeded sets completed; on failed, failure says why and nothing was debited.
phone comes back as digits only, country code included (2250712345678).
Secret key only (401 code unauthorized for a public key); 404 code not_found when the transfer is not in this workspace.

Errors are an HTTP 4xx/5xx status with a JSON body { "error": "<message>" }. Transfer endpoints add a machine-readable code, and so do some other refusals (code test_mode on payment links, rate_limited on webhook resends). A 401 says Missing API key or Invalid API Key.

spans: `pending`: created, not handed to the provider yet. `processing`: handed to the provider, the operator is processing it (the most frequent state right after the call). `succeeded`: the money reached the recipient, `completed` carries the date. `failed`: refused by the operator or the provider, `failure` says why, nothing was debited.
Key missing, invalid, or public key (`code: unauthorized`).
Not found in this workspace (`code: not_found`).
Errors are reported by the HTTP status code and a JSON body `{ "error": "<message>" }`.
API key missing or invalid: `Missing API key` or `Invalid API Key`
